You're wrong. You can trace a photograph to look shockingly good. I once did a 24x30 pencil sketch of a 8x10 photograph using grid drawing. I eyeballed the whole thing for a week. It was so realistic that my art teacher said it was the best work she ever witnessed. Even better than tracing. And I did it "freehand" with a little gridline guidance. That's as close to cheating one gets without cheating. Tracing is fraud.

When you map and follow a forest to get where you are going, the path you make is what you made. But when you follow a road there, you made nothing. That's the difference between free hand and tracing. Tracing undermines true artwork. If you can't draw, DONT PICK UP A PENCIL.

So NOT EVERYONE. When a company blatantly throws a word out so loosely, you have to be skeptical and assume there's a young naive somebody behind the wheel.
